bars.says: A visitor recognises a pale fungal woodland by its towering caps, ground-level biolight and milky pools under the tile’s actual sky, and can identify ordinary forage and hazards in it.

meant.intent: Land must visibly embody the selected mushroom cathedral and its local ecology. Recognisable forage and hazards make the picture usable.
meant.source: Owner-selected TheRot row in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md. Frozen the_rot.md sections 1, 4, 4b, 9. Delegated readability inference from ordinary colony use.

figurative.stands_for: A canopy and low cover made entirely from fungi, with existing giant cap architecture.
figurative.accept: An irregular fungus-only stand with overlapping caps and no conventional trees remains a woodland in this sense.

accept: An irregular stand of overlapping pale caps surrounds low glowing cover and milk shallows, with dark gaps between biological lights. Ordinary forage and a cloud-emitting Prime are recognisable on approach.
At the warm shoulder the actual low sun lights the same fungal structures, and the Sheen is named and shown as fungal sleet.
reject: A dark vanilla woodland has a pale tint, while its edible plants and danger patches disappear beneath opaque cap art.
Ordinary blue marsh and water rain occupy the described milk ponds and Sheen weather.
bars.lazy: none: Land and life readability. The sentence requires the actual fungal structures, useful light, fungal liquid identity and recognisable forage/hazards, closing the tinted-vanilla and display-only alternatives.

range.varies: Authored Rot shoulder arc 74..135 and historical ambient -42..24 C from the frozen sheet, using actual fixed-tile illumination. Natural stand densities at current defaults and mature overlap extremes. Clear/SheenFall/SheenStorm/SheenMist/DryThunderstorm, transition into each, dry and wet ground, normal play zoom and close inspection. All selected art variants are eligible, with no required variant count.
range.left_out: Planet placement and planetary tile counts. Color approval or regeneration of previously owner-kept art. Literal temple geometry.

accept: A worker follows open ground beneath overhanging caps, selects the intended stem and completes a haul or harvest without crossing its visible solid base.
A changed stand still supports a route to the same ordinary work area, with placements refusing a solid fungal contact.
reject: A worker walks through a visible trunk while the cap image selects a distant root.
A planted clearing works, but mature growth blocks all reachable forage or strands workers against newly occupied contacts.
bars.lazy: none: Land usable for ordinary play. Visible bases and completed work close collision-free art, wrong-root clicks and staged-clearing alternatives.

bars.says: Colonists meet a self-sustaining fungal food web whose forage, predators, tame products and flying natives work through ordinary harvesting, hunting and husbandry, with readable animal deaths and departures, and a colony can harvest a guarded Lussa crown, brew its pleasure cup on the day of harvest, and drink it there for chemical joy and a timed positive memory.

meant.intent: The life roster must function as encountered ecology and useful husbandry across its ordinary lifecycle. Standing flight and readable-loss rules are part of that experience.
meant.source: Frozen the_rot.md sections 4, 6 and 7b. Standing native-water, flight, no-vanishing and no-evictions rulings. Dustveil answer in rot_open_questions_2026-10-22.md. Delegated ordinary-lifecycle completeness. Owner marks of 2026-11-17 in owner_marks.md and CLEANSE_PLAN_OWNER_2026-11-17.md. RM_EuphoricCrown's plant description requires brewing on the day of harvest. Frozen the_rot.md forbids export of live preparations.

figurative.stands_for: Across the season the roster keeps eating, breeding, hunting and being refilled by ordinary wild spawning, without starving out or flooding. This is functioning open ecology, not a closed population maintained solely by births and diets.
figurative.accept: Ordinary wild-spawner arrivals replace predation losses while resident animals continue feeding, breeding and hunting; the population need not replace all losses through births.

accept: Foragers gather fungal food and building stock while predators feed in their usual habitat. Tamed brogg produce milk and tended dustveils yield silk through their normal lifecycle.
A native flyer crosses an obstacle by actual flight. A wounded native dies with a corpse or a readable death sign, while surviving animals remain accounted for after a reload.

A worker approaches a guarded Lussa crown through visible local spores, harvests it and brews the live crown on-site on the day it was cut. Drinking the cup there gives chemical joy and a positive memory that later expires.
reject: The roster is a static selection of named bodies that never eat, reproduce, yield products or hunt.
A moth bobs visually against a wall, or surplus wild giants silently disappear when the population cap runs.
An undefended crown yields a cup, a transported crown can be brewed off-site, or drinking the cup omits chemical joy or its timed positive memory.
A crown kept warm overnight still brews the following day, or a fresh exported cup grants joy or the memory.
bars.lazy: none: Life. Named roles must function through ordinary actions and real flight, with traceable deaths/departures. Decorative bodies and helper-created yields fail.

range.varies: Every current free-tier resident including body-only hwelgrue, plus historical external durrok/mullgoth when dependencies resolve. Wild/tamed, hungry/fed, young/adult, healthy/injured/dead, solitary/grouped, ground/pond-edge, direct and roofed access. Colony 1..40, population from normal initial spawn through a season of births and predation. Every fictional flyer includes thozzik colony/queen forms, illoth and dustveil. Ordinary Prime/Skulltop approach, cut and escape. Actual flight observations only in an owner-present session. Guarded crown approach and harvest, same-map and off-map preparation, harvest day and next local day, local ingestion and attempted export, ingredient viability, vessel build, research/work prerequisites, bill completion, ingestion, memory expiry, individual setting off/on, old settings and reload during preparation or the active memory.
range.left_out: Kin healing/wound transfer, chittik implantation, giant swallowing, deferred medical prizes and false-fruit crown-ring encounters, new animal assignments and perfect static population balance. Historical campaign species are a dependency uncertainty until composed state is read.

sees.instrument: Normal-job live state trace and the owner-present flight look, with M1 lifecycle situations and M4 food-chain forecast selecting worst cases. Existing paused Pawn_FlightTracker capability read is useful but insufficient for actual flight. T65/T69 provide lifecycle and automatic gas trace. T7 traces the local crown defense, normal harvest and on-site brewing through chemical joy and memory expiry with the wider medicine and crown-ring encounters off.
sees.start: Known wild and tamed cohorts in a default map, food supply and product counters recorded, no forced injury outcome or direct product spawn. Mat, weather, growth, decomposition and gas remain active.
sees.on: All retained mechanisms enabled at shipped defaults, next-version opt-ins off, all DLC, complete composed dependencies, unlocked normal jobs/research/terrain visibility appropriate to the task. No forced clear sky or disabled local gas, growth or animal metabolism.
sees.control: Dev-spawned products and manually triggered gas can fake functional ecology. Require product parent IDs and completion of ordinary milking/shearing/harvest jobs. A flyer with zero elapsed flight time fails the crossing observation. Match health loss to local gas emissions or attacks, including a safe-radius control. Count entities by identity through save, birth, death and departure. Record ordinary wild-spawner arrivals separately from births and developer spawns; spawner replenishment is allowed, while manual restocking cannot establish seasonal persistence. Read the crown's cloud and exposure on the approach and compare a protected approach. Trace crown identity and harvest day from normal harvest to brewing on the same map. Attempt the bill on another Rot map with the same viable ingredient and vessel to exclude a biome-only gate. Keep a matched crown warm and viable into the next local day and verify that the bill refuses it. Attempt to load a fresh cup for export. If a control forces that fresh cup to another map, verify it grants neither chemical joy nor the memory. Attribute both local effects to actual ingestion. Compare an unconsumed cup and a pleasure-brew-off run, keeping deferred medicine and guardian gates off throughout.
sees.reset: Restore the disposable starting fixture and its settings snapshot, discard generated descendants, then compare saved thing IDs, jobs, holder contents and logs against the baseline. Preserve failure evidence separately before reset. No canonical-world mutation.
sees.live_only_why: Autonomous animal choices, actual flight and ordinary job/lifecycle integration depend on the game scheduler. A stat or mocked lifecycle can miss a blocked diet, unusable job or walking flyer.

decision_tests.reject: Delegated rejection inference. The life roster must function as encountered ecology and useful husbandry across its ordinary lifecycle. Standing flight and readable-loss rules are part of that experience. The owner explicitly keeps the pleasure cup and its chemical joy and timed memory.
decision_tests.renormalize: Pictures bind causes and player-visible comparisons. Tuning values, yields and art variant counts are held in checks or ranges.

bars.says: Players can reduce routine backup heating in enclosed mat-floored rooms compared with matching inert-floor rooms, while the cold end of the Rot still requires colony protection.

meant.intent: Native metabolic heat is a genuine free benefit that reduces the colony heating burden and preserves the cold world.
meant.source: Frozen the_rot.md thermogenesis. Kit owner card 3 and later answered warm-mat question in rot_open_questions_2026-10-22.md. Delegated comparative test of “helps a lot”.

accept: A cold mat-floored bedroom lets the player run backup heating for less of its routine than in a matching inert-floor bedroom at the same occupied-room temperature, without feeding the ground.
Across the cold shoulder the player still provides insulation, clothing or heating despite the help from living floor.
reject: All rooms receive a global warm-biome offset whether they have living floor or inert flooring.
The mat produces a negligible thermometer twitch with no useful change to heating work, or makes the cold shoulder routinely comfortable without other protection.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires a practical reduction in routine backup heating linked to enclosed living floor, together with remaining cold protection. A thermometer twitch alone cannot satisfy that routine change.

Ambient -42..24 C, 1..40 occupants. Inert floor conversions, room merges/splits, growth, cold startup, steady operation and reload. Normal and roofed rock cover. Default heat settings, then off as a separate check.
range.left_out: Portable roots, warm pawn auras, sunlight overrides, outdoor ground-temperature simulation and guaranteed self-sufficient heating at the cold end.

bars.says: Players see exposed raw food spoil and corpses desiccate faster where the Rot’s digestion is active, with the effect tapering in the cold and walled and roofed storage escaping the acceleration.

meant.intent: Where the gut is active, exposure hastens spoilage and desiccation. Cold weakens digestion and enclosure shelters stores.
meant.source: Delegated from the_rot.md section 3 Thermogenesis and rot_kit_spec.md M2. The kit uses RotRateAtTemperature and calibrates against warm unrefrigerated meat. Kit owner card 2 confirms the walled-plus-roofed exemption. Q1 on the owner pages records the alternative reading of the sheet’s one-day rot clock.

figurative.stands_for: Temperature-scaled acceleration of vanilla rot stages, readable in food and corpse state.
figurative.accept: An exposed warm meat stack progresses through spoilage and vanishes at its normal rot endpoint without a moving mouth or gut organ.

accept: An exposed warm meat stack spoils sooner than a matched walled and roofed stack at the same temperature. The extra progress tapers toward the cold edge, where frozen exposed stacks keep vanilla preservation.

Where the gut is active, perishables spoil faster in a roofed lean-to until the player finishes its walls. Exposed corpses visibly rot and desiccate sooner than temperature-matched sheltered corpses and remain on the map.
reject: The frozen edge consumes exposed frozen stores at the same pace as warm ground, or warm exposed food spoils at the same pace as its temperature-matched vanilla control.
A roof canopy alone removes the digestive hazard, or a completed store receives the same accelerated loss as the open ground.
bars.lazy: none: Visible acceleration in active conditions, the cold taper and walls-plus-roof close ordinary warming and lean-to loopholes.

range.varies: Ambient -42..24 C with dense samples around freezing and separate positive-rate and frozen arms. Fresh/partly rotten/frozen food, whole/split/merged stacks, human/animal corpses with gear and corpse-holder reservations. Unroofed, lean-to, full room, roof gap, wall breach, doorway and map-edge room. 1..40 colonists and normal hauling/cooking/butchery overlap. Mid-exposure reload and room change before/after haul. C4 records the deadline in warm unrefrigerated conditions.
range.left_out: Live pawn consumption, unjoining/vat recovery, deconstructing inorganic wrecks, special giant digestion and next-version filth thinning. Vanilla owns ordinary rot stages and dirt handling.

bars.says: Players storing their usual harvest of living fungal food from the Rot must account for its heat when arranging refrigeration, and can preserve it by managing stock, enclosure and cooling.

meant.intent: Harvest carries the same metabolism into the store. The heat must affect practical storage choices while competent storage remains achievable.
meant.source: The_rot.md section 5 living harvest and kit M5 describe native fungal food heating its store. Delegated from that scope and the existing harvest defs, including ordinary forage currently yielding vanilla RawFungus.

figurative.stands_for: Fresh fungal food that retains its metabolically active heat contribution after harvest.
figurative.accept: A frozen fungal food stack remains heat-producing without simulating cell growth or an organism moving inside it.

accept: A freezer that preserves inert imports warms beyond preservation when loaded with a colony’s normal harvest of Rot fungal food, and a matching change to stock or cooling restores preservation.
Dividing, moving and recombining fungal stacks moves the warming load with the actual food, including after a reload.
reject: The colony eats and stores ordinary forage and never meets a freezer load.
A cosmetic warm label appears on the harvest but a stocked freezer behaves exactly like its ordinary-food control.
Produce heat rises independently of held stock or keeps storage unusable after the player removes the food and provides appropriate cooling.
bars.lazy: none: Ordinary harvest coverage, changed refrigeration decisions and successful mitigation close rare-crop demonstrations, cosmetic warmth and uncontrollable heaters.

range.varies: Ordinary Rot fungal forage, including harvests currently yielding RawFungus, and native fungal crops including RM_Glimmerslime and RM_RawDulcis. Sweep pure and mixed stores, 0..2000 units per room as initial support, stack split/merge and the maximum normal stock of a 40-person colony. Recompute tested stock/cooling ratios after tuning to cover both sides of the preservation boundary. Rooms 3x3..30x30, inert/mat floor, cooling off/normal/expanded, ambient -42..24 C, frozen/chilled/room-temperature food, haul/cook/eat/destroy, room merge/split and reload. Vanilla RawFungus, other inert imports, cooked meals and non-food products enter the zero-load arm.
range.left_out: Heat from special teas, genes, portable roots or grown furnaces. A fixed cooler count, food yield, heat-per-unit or storage capacity as acceptance.

sees.start: Matched stores from ordinary Rot harvest and inert imports, with nutrition/storage mass and ordinary cooling capacity recorded and no special hidden heater. An empty store establishes zero load.

bars.says: Over a season in the complete Rot, a colony can keep using fungal shelter, harvest and storage while the forest and its native food web renew, with understandable losses and workable routes through weather changes, a reload and reordered colony work.

meant.intent: Whole first-version play must remain a functioning cold fungal place with metabolic help and hunger operating together. A stable staged slice is insufficient.
meant.source: Delegated from owner whole-system requirement in this brief, the selected Rot experience, frozen ecosystem/thermogenesis/rot-clock intent and standing no-vanishing rule. Owner mark of 2026-11-17 in owner_marks.md retains the pleasure cup in this complete version.

accept: The settled colony hauls and cooks, its living-floor rooms save heating, and the ordinary fungal forage and crops it relies on for meals create a cooling decision in storage while the full forest grows, local hazards run and native animals feed and reproduce.
After saving during active harvest and reloading, expanding storage before harvest and harvesting before expanding storage both yield understandable consequences and recoverable colony work.
Guarded crown harvest, on-site brewing and cup consumption continue alongside storage work across reload, with chemical joy and memory expiry visible and the wider medicine/guardian suite dormant.
reject: A staged colony looks stable because weather, local gas, wet-native growth or digestion is locked or disabled, or the freezer load only appears when the tester stocks special crops outside the colony’s normal diet.
Growth and gas consume the usable forest, native animals starve away, routine jobs stall, losses have no readable cause or recurring errors drown out play.
bars.lazy: none: Whole land, life and signature. Complete default operation, explicit change/save/work sequence and renewal close disabled-system showcases, static dioramas and supply-cache masking.

range.varies: Exactly the complete first version at factory defaults with all kept systems on and unlocked, next-version extras off. Full supported maps from 200..400 cells per side, flat/rocky/milk-shallows layouts, authored cold/middle/warm shoulder regimes, all actual weather states with natural selection left running, initial and mature stand density. A full 15-day in-game season, paired starts with 3 and 40 colonists, then a 100-day M4 extension to detect delayed drift. Save/load around day 7 during held harvest/haul and room changes. Main sequence enclose/store/harvest/cool then harvest/enclose/cool/store in a fresh sibling run. Compression only accelerates elapsed ticks or a calibrated offline integration step, preserving job scheduling, pawn metabolism, weather selection/RNG, plant/animal cadence, deadlines, room rebuilding, damage, reproduction and save clocks. Any skipped system invalidates the live reading. Natural rare states may be covered by M1 sibling fixtures in addition to the uninterrupted season, never by replacing its weather schedule. Include normal pleasure-cup production/consumption and saved ingredient/cup/memory transitions under T7.
range.left_out: Deferred quests, rituals and exotic rewards. Subjective enjoyment. Exact equilibrium populations, yields, time budget or variant totals. Planet generation or canonical save changes.

sees.instrument: M4 whole-map forecast calibrated against normal complete-map telemetry, followed by an agent-run live whole-season state trace that reads native flyers through Pawn_FlightTracker. The short owner-present flight look is a separate B3 obligation. T62 specifies the driver and reload/action-order ledger. B1 through B6 supply its other observations.
sees.start: A disposable complete Rot map with measured active def/settings/art/engine fingerprints, food and animal IDs recorded, normal work priorities and all doors/stockpiles/jobs usable. No debug immortality, frozen hunger, forced products or permanent weather condition. Starting supplies cover setup but ongoing food/heat/cooling must come from the declared normal economy.
sees.on: All retained mechanisms enabled at shipped defaults, next-version opt-ins off, all DLC, complete composed dependencies, unlocked normal jobs/research/terrain visibility appropriate to the task. No forced clear sky or disabled local gas, growth or animal metabolism.
sees.control: An initial supply cache, external heater or specially stocked crop could mask the ordinary colony economy. Account initial inputs, normal harvest, storage, consumption and power through the whole season. Trace freezer load and the response to it from the same harvest feeding the colony, and expose failed jobs and food/corpse causes by identity. Keep natural weather selection active and report time in each state. Compare uninterrupted and reloaded/action-order sibling traces.
sees.reset: Restore the disposable starting fixture and its settings snapshot, discard generated descendants, then compare saved thing IDs, jobs, holder contents and logs against the baseline. Preserve failure evidence separately before reset. No canonical-world mutation.
sees.live_only_why: The coupled player experience includes route readability, ordinary jobs, animal decisions, weather, saves and long-term feedback. An offline forecast informs extremes after calibration, while normal whole-colony play establishes the complete experience.

decision_tests.reject: Delegated rejection inference. Whole first-version play must remain a functioning cold fungal place with metabolic help and hunger operating together. A stable staged slice is insufficient.
decision_tests.renormalize: Pictures bind causes and player-visible comparisons. Tuning values, yields and art variant counts are held in checks or ranges.
decision_tests.first_version: Whole land, life and signature. Complete default operation, explicit change/save/work sequence and renewal close disabled-system showcases, static dioramas and supply-cache masking.

checks.what: Snapshot resolved source/assembly/art/settings/engine and composed mod fingerprints before any proof. Current proposal claims no gameplay fingerprint agreement.
Use existing donor-name, selectable, glower, live-prep, Dustveil and cartoon-retirement selftests as scoped regression readings. Field/asset counts are diagnostics, outside passing bars.
Read inherited positive animal/plant density, actual element-form rosters and default weather pool. Keep current authored density intent without making exact density or variant counts bars.

Read the 60000-tick raw-meat loss target in warm unrefrigerated exposure where the gut is active. Check diminishing bonus RotProgress as the temperature-driven rate falls and zero bonus for frozen items. Check walled-plus-roofed exemption separately per kit owner card 2.

Record warm-floor terrain set, configured required floor fraction, offset and max room temperature. Current source comments/extension contract use a 21 C ceiling and 250-tick sweep. Confirm actual resolved values before comparison.

Record living-produce attachments on native fungal foods from ordinary forage and crops and check stack-to-room aggregation. Read vanilla RawFungus as an inert control. Source default heatPerUnit is 3.5 per 2000-tick sweep. Zero XML attachments found in this checkout is a binding gap.

Read missing-field and old-settings migrations, new default-off opt-ins, actual job/incident/letter/effect suppression, all-off load and per-feature restore. Unrelated shared engine consumers must retain their behavior.

For every fictional flyer record resolved MaxFlightTime, tracker capability and directional flip-book assets. Existing paused state test is capability evidence only. Actual flight judgment obeys owner-present rule.

Count ordinary product/lifecycle/food-chain events by entity identity, including eggs, larva metamorphosis, asexual reproduction, gas-emitter tick callbacks and milk/silk jobs. Direct helper invocation is recorded separately.
Record current giant contact masks, flips, growth scales, footprint/texture fingerprints and resolved selection bounds. Reuse HugeThings tools, with off-map/model assumptions calibrated before trust.

meetings.why: Dense giant contacts, wet-native turnover, gas patches, wrecks and colony building all compete for the same routes. Pairwise open clearings cannot establish full-map reachability after a growth/room transition.

B1 needs visible biological sources and dark gaps, B3 uses native light and B7 keeps them through the season. R8 uses actual glower positions and tile sky. A glower changes visibility and ordinary behavior through the game light grid, without a competing custom global brightness rule. Independent light-source auditing closes the masking explanation.

Milk affordances, bridge support, native drinking, fungi sowing, giant roots and warm-floor qualification share the same terrain grid. A renamed vanilla marsh could preserve paths while violating the substrate contract.

Natural emission rotation and milk wet classification feed an already active wet-native Churn engine while resident gas affects food and workers. Repeated wetting could produce dense turnover or flood the forest with hazards.

Predators, native gas, food spoilage, wet-native regrowth and reproduction can remove food faster than renewal or amplify spawn/product loops. Retained bodies and disabled special guts still need ordinary sustaining diet. M4 includes the local exposure around harvestable Lussa crowns.

Routes, hauling deadlines, enclosure repairs, plant turnover and thermal stock management meet at a forty-person base. The intended stable routine is unmeasured and aggregate rates may create a persistent job stall. M4 includes travel to guarded crowns and on-site brewing work.

Hauling, rescue/butchery reservations, corpse stage changes, native predation, Bones products and old extra holders meet on the same entity. Completion and reload order can lose gear or duplicate a job’s outputs.

Floor heat, harvest heat, Sheen temperature, thermal leakage and cooling meet in the same rooms. A room pair at a single temperature cannot establish useful assistance and workable refrigeration throughout the shoulder.
Digestive exposure changes with enclosure while mat and stock change temperature. A warm stack can restart rot after thawing, and missing markers on ordinary forage could hide the freezer load.

All callers of moved behavior must pass explicit opt-in before acquiring or advancing effects. Reference-compatible defs let old saves load and preservation migrations keep holders recoverable. The common scanner and animal bodies refer to enabled ordinary content. This construction permits all bars together, with T61 and each containment ticket checking implementation. Existing missing gates are repairs rather than logical scope conflicts. T7 keeps its guard, vessel and viability path independent of deferred recipes and crown rings.
